Name: Virtual Keyboard PLUS
Author: Gabrieukkj

[heading]Installation[/heading]
[i]You need to [b]replace[/b] the [b][url=https://github.com/ZaneYork/SMAPI-Android-Installer/releases]original MOD[/url][/b] files inside the folder to install this MOD. (Or the "config.json" will be replaced by SMAPI to the original Virtual Keyboard configs.)[/i]

[heading]Technical Information[/heading]
[i]This mod was tested on:[/i]
[list]
[*] SMAPI V3.18.3
[*] Stardew Valley 1.5.6.39
[/list]
[heading]Information[/heading]
[i]Keys Added:[/i]
[list]
[*]A-Z letters
[*]F1-F12 "Fs"
[*]Esc, Lshift, Tab, Control
[/list]
[spoiler]Give me updates ideas and your opinion about the mod in the comments![/spoiler]
